body: TCP MUD on :2323. Login → zone description → mobs → exits. Commands: look/l, n/s/e/w, attack, stop, ws (weapon skill, 3x dmg), mine, mine-points, status, who, say, tell, map, mobs, help, quit. Full integration: zone.Manager, mob.Registry+TickPlayer+Tick, combat/tp.TPState, status.Stack, gather.MiningPoint, all 4 zones, leech/slime/lizard mobs, worm burrow events, 1Hz game loop.
title: DragonsNShit MUD server (apps2/mud) — playable TCP MUD integrating all server packages
